```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(recipes)
library(uwot)
library(forcats)
library(beepr)
library(yardstick)
```

```{r}
#load dataset:
#150cm:
pedon_pack_150_p <- read.csv("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_02_26_26.csv")

set.seed(1)

df <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxorder = factor(taxorder)
  )

# lump rare orders to avoid dropped-level issues in resampling
min_n <- 15
df <- df %>%
  mutate(taxorder = fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = min_n, other_level = "Other"))

count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

df <- df %>% filter(taxorder != "Other")
df <- df %>% droplevels()
count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
```

```{r}
rec <- recipe(taxorder ~ ., data = train) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize"
  ))) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%          # move this UP
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec <- prep(rec)

x_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train) %>% select(-taxorder, -peiid)
x_test  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test)  %>% select(-taxorder, -peiid)

# convert logical predictors to 0/1
x_train <- x_train %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
x_test  <- x_test  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

# safety: ensure all numeric
stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train, is.numeric, logical(1))))
```

```{r}
set.seed(2)
umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train),
  n_components = 10,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
names(z_train) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train)))

z_test <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test), umap_fit))
names(z_test) <- names(z_train)

train_umap <- bind_cols(z_train, taxorder = train$taxorder)
test_umap  <- bind_cols(z_test,  taxorder = test$taxorder)
```

```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

rf_fit <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(taxorder ~ .) %>%
  fit(train_umap)

pred_class <- predict(rf_fit, test_umap, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap %>% select(taxorder))

conf_mat(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)
accuracy(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)
```

```{r}
rf_spec_tune <- rand_forest(trees = 1000, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_tune <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_tune) %>%
  add_formula(taxorder ~ .)

set.seed(3)
folds <- vfold_cv(train_umap, v = 5, strata = taxorder)

grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, 10)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 25)),
  levels = 5
)

tuned <- tune_grid(
  wf_tune, resamples = folds, grid = grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap)
)
beepr::beep("wilhelm")
best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "kap")
rf_final <- finalize_workflow(wf_tune, best) %>%
  fit(train_umap)
pred <- predict(rf_final, test_umap, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final, test_umap, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap %>% select(taxorder))

conf_mat(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)
kap(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)

pred_conf <- pred %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    max_prob = max(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$")))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    mean_max_prob = mean(max_prob),
    pct_low_conf  = mean(max_prob < 0.5)
  )
pred_conf

```

```{r}
conf_mat(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)

# per-class stats (super important if classes are imbal)
pred %>% yardstick::precision(truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
pred %>% yardstick::recall(truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
pred %>% yardstick::f_meas(truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
```
```{r}
pred <- pred %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(max_prob = max(c_across(where(is.numeric) & starts_with(".pred_")))) %>%
  ungroup()

pred %>%
  mutate(low_conf = max_prob < 0.5) %>%
  count(taxorder, low_conf, sort = TRUE)

pred_class <- pred %>%
  select(taxorder, .pred_class)

yardstick::bal_accuracy(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)

f_meas(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
recall(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
precision(pred_class, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")
```


```{r}
# 1) Class counts (train + test)
cat("\n=== FULL DATA COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE))

cat("\n=== TRAIN COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(train, taxorder, sort = TRUE))

cat("\n=== TEST COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(test, taxorder, sort = TRUE))

# 2) Confusion matrix (full)
cat("\n=== CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class))

# 3) Key metrics (overall + macro)
cat("\n=== METRICS (overall) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== MACRO METRICS ===\n")
print(precision(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))
print(recall(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))
print(f_meas(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

# 4) Per-class performance (this is the most diagnostic)
cat("\n=== PER-CLASS METRICS ===\n")
print(precision(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro_weighted")) # optional
print(recall(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro_weighted"))   # optional


cat("\n=== BY-CLASS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(conf_mat(pred, truth = taxorder, estimate = .pred_class)))

#So: the model works, but it’s blind to Alfisols.
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# GREAT GROUP MODEL (taxgrtgroup)
# ============================================================

set.seed(11)

df_gg <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxgrtgroup = factor(taxgrtgroup)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxgrtgroup), taxgrtgroup != "") %>%
  droplevels()

# Lump rare great groups (you almost always need this)
# Start with 10–20; increase if you still see dropped-level warnings in CV
min_n_gg <- 20
df_gg <- df_gg %>%
  mutate(taxgrtgroup = fct_lump_min(taxgrtgroup, min = min_n_gg, other_level = "Other")) %>%
  filter(taxgrtgroup != "Other") %>%   # you can keep Other if you want, but it’s often messy
  droplevels()

cat("\n=== GREAT GROUP COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(df_gg, taxgrtgroup, sort = TRUE))

split_gg <- initial_split(df_gg, prop = 0.8, strata = taxgrtgroup)
train_gg <- training(split_gg)
test_gg  <- testing(split_gg)

# --- recipe: drop taxonomy leaks (everything except taxgrtgroup)
rec_gg <- recipe(taxgrtgroup ~ ., data = train_gg) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxpartsize"
  ))) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_gg <- prep(rec_gg)

x_train_gg <- bake(prep_rec_gg, new_data = train_gg) %>% select(-taxgrtgroup, -peiid)
x_test_gg  <- bake(prep_rec_gg, new_data = test_gg)  %>% select(-taxgrtgroup, -peiid)

x_train_gg <- x_train_gg %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
x_test_gg  <- x_test_gg  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train_gg, is.numeric, logical(1))))

# --- UMAP
set.seed(12)
umap_fit_gg <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_gg),
  n_components = 15,     # often helps for many-class problems
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train_gg <- as.data.frame(umap_fit_gg$embedding)
names(z_train_gg) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_gg)))

z_test_gg <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_gg), umap_fit_gg))
names(z_test_gg) <- names(z_train_gg)

train_umap_gg <- bind_cols(z_train_gg, taxgrtgroup = train_gg$taxgrtgroup)
test_umap_gg  <- bind_cols(z_test_gg,  taxgrtgroup = test_gg$taxgrtgroup)

# --- RF tune (recommended for GG)
rf_spec_tune_gg <- rand_forest(trees = 1500, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_tune_gg <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_tune_gg) %>%
  add_formula(taxgrtgroup ~ .)

set.seed(13)
folds_gg <- vfold_cv(train_umap_gg, v = 5, strata = taxgrtgroup)

# mtry upper bound should not exceed number of UMAP components (here 15)
grid_gg <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, 15)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 30)),
  levels = 5
)

tuned_gg <- tune_grid(
  wf_tune_gg, resamples = folds_gg, grid = grid_gg,
  metrics = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap)
)
beepr::beep("wilhelm")

best_gg <- select_best(tuned_gg, metric = "bal_accuracy")

rf_final_gg <- finalize_workflow(wf_tune_gg, best_gg) %>%
  fit(train_umap_gg)

pred_gg <- predict(rf_final_gg, test_umap_gg, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_gg, test_umap_gg, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap_gg %>% select(taxgrtgroup))
pred_gg <- pred_gg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    probs = list(c_across(where(is.numeric) & starts_with(".pred_"))),
    top1   = max(probs),
    top2   = sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top1 - top2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pred_gg %>%
  summarise(
    mean_top1 = mean(top1),
    pct_low_top1 = mean(top1 < 0.5),
    mean_margin = mean(margin),
    pct_low_margin = mean(margin < 0.15)
  )
cat("\n=== GREAT GROUP CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== GREAT GROUP METRICS ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup, estimate = .pred_class))
print(f_meas(pred_gg, truth = taxgrtgroup, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

# Confidence summary
pred_conf_gg <- pred_gg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(max_prob = max(c_across(where(is.numeric) & starts_with(".pred_")))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    mean_max_prob = mean(max_prob),
    pct_low_conf  = mean(max_prob < 0.5)
  )

cat("\n=== GREAT GROUP CONFIDENCE ===\n")
print(pred_conf_gg)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MODIFIER-1 MODEL (taxsubgrp_mod1) - with rare modifiers dropped
# ============================================================

set.seed(21)

min_n_mod1 <- 8

df_sg1 <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = as.character(taxsubgrp_mod1),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = str_squish(taxsubgrp_mod1),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = na_if(taxsubgrp_mod1, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  add_count(taxsubgrp_mod1, name = "class_n") %>%
  filter(class_n >= min_n_mod1) %>%
  select(-class_n) %>%
  mutate(taxsubgrp_mod1 = factor(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\n=== MOD1 COUNTS AFTER FILTERING ===\n")
print(count(df_sg1, taxsubgrp_mod1, sort = TRUE))

split_sg1 <- initial_split(df_sg1, prop = 0.8, strata = taxsubgrp_mod1)
train_sg1 <- training(split_sg1)
test_sg1  <- testing(split_sg1)

# drop obvious taxonomy leaks
train_sg1 <- train_sg1 %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3"
  )))

test_sg1 <- test_sg1 %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3"
  )))

# logical -> integer
train_sg1 <- train_sg1 %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
test_sg1  <- test_sg1  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

# remove leftover character predictors except peiid
char_preds <- names(train_sg1)[vapply(train_sg1, is.character, logical(1))]
char_preds <- setdiff(char_preds, "peiid")

if (length(char_preds) > 0) {
  train_sg1 <- train_sg1 %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
  test_sg1  <- test_sg1  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
}

# remove one-value predictors based on training data
pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_sg1), c("peiid", "taxsubgrp_mod1"))
one_val <- pred_names[
  vapply(train_sg1[pred_names], function(x) {
    length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1
  }, logical(1))
]

if (length(one_val) > 0) {
  train_sg1 <- train_sg1 %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
  test_sg1  <- test_sg1  %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
}

rec_sg1 <- recipe(taxsubgrp_mod1 ~ ., data = train_sg1) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_sg1 <- prep(rec_sg1)

x_train_sg1 <- bake(prep_rec_sg1, new_data = train_sg1) %>%
  select(-taxsubgrp_mod1, -peiid)

x_test_sg1 <- bake(prep_rec_sg1, new_data = test_sg1) %>%
  select(-taxsubgrp_mod1, -peiid)

cat("x_train rows:", nrow(x_train_sg1), "\n")
cat("x_train cols:", ncol(x_train_sg1), "\n")

# UMAP
set.seed(22)
n_neighbors_sg1  <- min(15, nrow(x_train_sg1) - 1)
n_components_sg1 <- min(10, ncol(x_train_sg1))

umap_fit_sg1 <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_sg1),
  n_components = n_components_sg1,
  n_neighbors = n_neighbors_sg1,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train_sg1 <- as.data.frame(umap_fit_sg1$embedding)
names(z_train_sg1) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_sg1)))

z_test_sg1 <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_sg1), umap_fit_sg1))
names(z_test_sg1) <- names(z_train_sg1)

train_umap_sg1 <- bind_cols(z_train_sg1, taxsubgrp_mod1 = train_sg1$taxsubgrp_mod1)
test_umap_sg1  <- bind_cols(z_test_sg1,  taxsubgrp_mod1 = test_sg1$taxsubgrp_mod1)

# safer CV size
min_class_train <- train_umap_sg1 %>%
  count(taxsubgrp_mod1) %>%
  summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
  pull(min_n)

v_sg1 <- min(5, min_class_train)
if (v_sg1 < 2) stop("At least one class still has <2 training samples after filtering.")

set.seed(23)
folds_sg1 <- vfold_cv(train_umap_sg1, v = v_sg1, strata = taxsubgrp_mod1)

rf_spec_tune_sg1 <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1500,
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_tune_sg1 <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_tune_sg1) %>%
  add_formula(taxsubgrp_mod1 ~ .)

grid_sg1 <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(10, ncol(z_train_sg1)))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
  levels = 4
)

tuned_sg1 <- tune_grid(
  wf_tune_sg1,
  resamples = folds_sg1,
  grid = grid_sg1,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)
)

collect_metrics(tuned_sg1)
collect_notes(tuned_sg1)

best_sg1 <- select_best(tuned_sg1, metric = "bal_accuracy")

rf_final_sg1 <- finalize_workflow(wf_tune_sg1, best_sg1) %>%
  fit(train_umap_sg1)

pred_sg1 <- predict(rf_final_sg1, test_umap_sg1, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_sg1, test_umap_sg1, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap_sg1 %>% select(taxsubgrp_mod1))

cat("\n=== MOD1 METRICS (ALL ORDERS) ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_sg1,
  truth = taxsubgrp_mod1,
  estimate = .pred_class
))
print(f_meas(
  pred_sg1,
  truth = taxsubgrp_mod1,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
))

cat("\n=== MOD1 CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred_sg1, truth = taxsubgrp_mod1, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== MOD1 CONFUSION MATRIX SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(conf_mat(pred_sg1, truth = taxsubgrp_mod1, estimate = .pred_class)))

cat("\n=== MOD1 TRUTH VS PREDICTED COUNTS ===\n")
print(
  pred_sg1 %>%
    count(taxsubgrp_mod1, .pred_class, sort = TRUE)
)
metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_sg1,
  truth = taxsubgrp_mod1,
  estimate = .pred_class
)

# Confidence summary
pred_conf_sg1 <- pred_sg1 %>%
 rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    probs = list(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$"))),
    top1   = max(probs),
    top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
    margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 CONFIDENCE ===\n")
print(
  pred_conf_sg1 %>%
    summarise(
      mean_top1      = mean(top1, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_top1   = mean(top1 < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_margin    = mean(margin, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_margin = mean(margin < 0.15, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# ULTISOLS ONLY: taxsubgrp_mod1 prediction
# ============================================================

set.seed(31)

min_n_mod1_u <- 8   # adjust up/down if needed

df_u <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxorder = str_squish(as.character(taxorder)),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = str_squish(as.character(taxsubgrp_mod1)),
    taxsubgrp_mod1 = na_if(taxsubgrp_mod1, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(taxorder == "Ultisols") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  add_count(taxsubgrp_mod1, name = "class_n") %>%
  filter(class_n >= min_n_mod1_u) %>%
  select(-class_n) %>%
  mutate(taxsubgrp_mod1 = factor(taxsubgrp_mod1)) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 COUNTS ===\n")
print(count(df_u, taxsubgrp_mod1, sort = TRUE))

split_u <- initial_split(df_u, prop = 0.8, strata = taxsubgrp_mod1)
train_u <- training(split_u)
test_u  <- testing(split_u)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Drop taxonomy leaks
# ------------------------------------------------------------
train_u <- train_u %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3"
  )))

test_u <- test_u %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxpartsize",
    "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3"
  )))

# logical -> integer
train_u <- train_u %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
test_u  <- test_u  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

# drop leftover character predictors except peiid
char_preds_u <- names(train_u)[vapply(train_u, is.character, logical(1))]
char_preds_u <- setdiff(char_preds_u, "peiid")

if (length(char_preds_u) > 0) {
  cat("\nDropping remaining character predictors:\n")
  print(char_preds_u)
  train_u <- train_u %>% select(-all_of(char_preds_u))
  test_u  <- test_u  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds_u))
}

# drop one-value predictors based on training set
pred_names_u <- setdiff(names(train_u), c("peiid", "taxsubgrp_mod1"))

one_val_u <- pred_names_u[
  vapply(train_u[pred_names_u], function(x) {
    length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1
  }, logical(1))
]

if (length(one_val_u) > 0) {
  cat("\nDropping one-value predictors:\n")
  print(one_val_u)
  train_u <- train_u %>% select(-all_of(one_val_u))
  test_u  <- test_u  %>% select(-all_of(one_val_u))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Recipe
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rec_u <- recipe(taxsubgrp_mod1 ~ ., data = train_u) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_rec_u <- prep(rec_u)

x_train_u <- bake(prep_rec_u, new_data = train_u) %>%
  select(-taxsubgrp_mod1, -peiid)

x_test_u <- bake(prep_rec_u, new_data = test_u) %>%
  select(-taxsubgrp_mod1, -peiid)

cat("\nTrain rows:", nrow(x_train_u), "\n")
cat("Train cols:", ncol(x_train_u), "\n")

if (ncol(x_train_u) < 2) stop("Too few predictor columns left for UMAP.")
if (nrow(x_train_u) < 3) stop("Too few training rows for UMAP.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# UMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(32)

n_neighbors_u  <- min(15, nrow(x_train_u) - 1)
n_components_u <- min(10, ncol(x_train_u))

umap_fit_u <- uwot::umap(
  as.matrix(x_train_u),
  n_components = n_components_u,
  n_neighbors = n_neighbors_u,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  ret_model = TRUE
)

z_train_u <- as.data.frame(umap_fit_u$embedding)
names(z_train_u) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train_u)))

z_test_u <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test_u), umap_fit_u))
names(z_test_u) <- names(z_train_u)

train_umap_u <- bind_cols(z_train_u, taxsubgrp_mod1 = train_u$taxsubgrp_mod1)
test_umap_u  <- bind_cols(z_test_u,  taxsubgrp_mod1 = test_u$taxsubgrp_mod1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# RF tuning
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rf_spec_tune_u <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1500,
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf_tune_u <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec_tune_u) %>%
  add_formula(taxsubgrp_mod1 ~ .)

min_class_train_u <- train_umap_u %>%
  count(taxsubgrp_mod1) %>%
  summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
  pull(min_n)

v_u <- min(5, min_class_train_u)
if (v_u < 2) stop("At least one Ultisol modifier class has <2 training samples after filtering.")

set.seed(33)
folds_u <- vfold_cv(train_umap_u, v = v_u, strata = taxsubgrp_mod1)

grid_u <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, min(10, ncol(z_train_u)))),
  min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
  levels = 4
)

tuned_u <- tune_grid(
  wf_tune_u,
  resamples = folds_u,
  grid = grid_u,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)
)

cat("\n=== TUNING METRICS ===\n")
print(collect_metrics(tuned_u))

cat("\n=== TUNING NOTES ===\n")
print(collect_notes(tuned_u))

best_u <- select_best(tuned_u, metric = "bal_accuracy")

rf_final_u <- finalize_workflow(wf_tune_u, best_u) %>%
  fit(train_umap_u)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final predictions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pred_u <- predict(rf_final_u, test_umap_u, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final_u, test_umap_u, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_umap_u %>% select(taxsubgrp_mod1))

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 METRICS ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
  pred_u,
  truth = taxsubgrp_mod1,
  estimate = .pred_class
))

print(f_meas(
  pred_u,
  truth = taxsubgrp_mod1,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  estimator = "macro"
))

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred_u, truth = taxsubgrp_mod1, estimate = .pred_class))

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 CONFUSION MATRIX SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(conf_mat(pred_u, truth = taxsubgrp_mod1, estimate = .pred_class)))

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: TRUTH VS PREDICTED COUNTS ===\n")
print(
  pred_u %>%
    count(taxsubgrp_mod1, .pred_class, sort = TRUE)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Confidence + margin
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pred_u <- pred_u %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    probs = list(c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$"))),
    top1   = max(probs),
    top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
    margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== ULTISOLS ONLY: MOD1 CONFIDENCE ===\n")
print(
  pred_u %>%
    summarise(
      mean_top1      = mean(top1, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_top1   = mean(top1 < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_margin    = mean(margin, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_low_margin = mean(margin < 0.15, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)
```

### NO UMAPS:
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SETUP + HELPERS
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(recipes)
library(yardstick)
library(ranger)
library(beepr)

pedon_pack_150_p <- read.csv("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_02_26_26.csv")

drop_bad_predictors <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid", drop_cols = NULL) {
  train_df <- train_df %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))
  
  # logical -> integer
  train_df <- train_df %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  test_df  <- test_df  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
  
  # drop leftover character predictors except id/outcome
  char_preds <- names(train_df)[vapply(train_df, is.character, logical(1))]
  char_preds <- setdiff(char_preds, c(id_col, outcome))
  
  if (length(char_preds) > 0) {
    cat("\nDropping remaining character predictors:\n")
    print(char_preds)
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(char_preds))
  }
  
  # drop one-value predictors based on training set
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), c(id_col, outcome))
  
  one_val <- pred_names[
    vapply(train_df[pred_names], function(x) {
      length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) <= 1
    }, logical(1))
  ]
  
  if (length(one_val) > 0) {
    cat("\nDropping one-value predictors:\n")
    print(one_val)
    train_df <- train_df %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
    test_df  <- test_df  %>% select(-all_of(one_val))
  }
  
  list(train = train_df, test = test_df)
}

fit_rf_direct <- function(train_df, test_df, outcome, id_col = "peiid",
                          trees = 1500, grid_levels = 4,
                          metric_for_best = "bal_accuracy") {
  
  outcome_sym <- rlang::sym(outcome)
  form <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ."))
  
  rec <- recipe(form, data = train_df) %>%
    update_role(all_of(id_col), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df, retain = TRUE)
  
  x_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df) %>%
    select(-all_of(c(outcome, id_col)))
  
  p <- ncol(x_train)
  if (p < 1) stop("No usable predictor columns remain.")
  
  min_class_n <- train_df %>%
    count(!!outcome_sym) %>%
    summarise(min_n = min(n)) %>%
    pull(min_n)
  
  v <- min(5, min_class_n)
  if (v < 2) stop("At least one class has <2 training samples.")
  
  rf_spec <- rand_forest(
    trees = trees,
    mtry = tune(),
    min_n = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("classification")
  
  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(rf_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)
  
  folds <- vfold_cv(train_df, v = v, strata = !!outcome_sym)
  
  grid <- grid_regular(
    mtry(range = c(1, min(10, p))),
    min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
    levels = grid_levels
  )
  
  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid,
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)
  )
  
  notes <- collect_notes(tuned)
  metrics <- collect_metrics(tuned)
  
  cat("\n=== TUNING METRICS ===\n")
  print(metrics)
  
  cat("\n=== TUNING NOTES ===\n")
  print(notes)
  
  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = metric_for_best)
  
  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>%
    fit(train_df)
  
  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_df, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_df %>% select(all_of(outcome)))
  
  cm <- conf_mat(pred, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class)
  
  pred_conf <- pred %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      probs  = c_across(starts_with(".pred_") & !matches("^\\.pred_class$")),
      top1   = max(probs),
      top2   = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, sort(probs, decreasing = TRUE)[2], NA_real_),
      margin = ifelse(length(probs) > 1, top1 - top2, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  list(
    recipe = rec,
    tuned = tuned,
    best = best,
    final_fit = final_fit,
    pred = pred_conf,
    conf_mat = cm,
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(
      pred, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class
    ),
    f_meas = f_meas(
      pred, truth = !!outcome_sym, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== MOD1 FINAL METRICS ===\n")
print(res_mod1$metrics)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PARTSIZE MODEL (NO UMAP): RF on baked predictors
# ============================================================

set.seed(101)

# Build df_ps (drop "not used" already handled; keep here for safety)
df_ps <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxpartsize = factor(taxpartsize)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxpartsize), taxpartsize != "", taxpartsize != "not used") %>%
  droplevels()

# Optionally lump very rare classes (fine-silty is tiny)
# Uncomment if you want stability over completeness:
# df_ps <- df_ps %>%
#   mutate(taxpartsize = fct_collapse(taxpartsize, Other_ps = c("fine-silty"))) %>%
#   droplevels()

cat("\n=== PARTSIZE COUNTS (NO UMAP) ===\n")
print(count(df_ps, taxpartsize, sort = TRUE))

split_ps <- initial_split(df_ps, prop = 0.8, strata = taxpartsize)
train_ps <- training(split_ps)
test_ps  <- testing(split_ps)

# Recipe: drop taxonomy leaks, encode/impute/normalize
rec_ps <- recipe(taxpartsize ~ ., data = train_ps) %>%
  update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(any_of(c(
    "taxonname_clean",
    "taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup", "taxsubgrp"
  ))) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

prep_ps <- prep(rec_ps)

x_train_ps <- bake(prep_ps, new_data = train_ps) %>% select(-taxpartsize, -peiid)
x_test_ps  <- bake(prep_ps, new_data = test_ps)  %>% select(-taxpartsize, -peiid)

x_train_ps <- x_train_ps %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))
x_test_ps  <- x_test_ps  %>% mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.integer))

stopifnot(all(vapply(x_train_ps, is.numeric, logical(1))))

train_rf <- bind_cols(x_train_ps, taxpartsize = train_ps$taxpartsize)
test_rf  <- bind_cols(x_test_ps,  taxpartsize = test_ps$taxpartsize)

# Class weights (helps minority classes)
tab_ps <- table(train_rf$taxpartsize)
cw_ps <- as.numeric(sum(tab_ps) / (length(tab_ps) * tab_ps))
names(cw_ps) <- names(tab_ps)

# Tunable RF
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 2000, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger",
             probability = TRUE,
             importance = "permutation",
             class.weights = cw_ps) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(taxpartsize ~ .)

set.seed(102)
folds <- vfold_cv(train_rf, v = 5, strata = taxpartsize)

# mtry upper bound should relate to # predictors; keep it reasonable
p <- ncol(x_train_ps)
mtry_max <- min(50, p)

grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, mtry_max)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 40)),
  levels = 5
)

tuned <- tune_grid(
  wf, resamples = folds, grid = grid,
  metrics = metric_set(bal_accuracy, kap)
)

best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "kap")
rf_final <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>% fit(train_rf)

rf_final <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>%
  fit(train_rf)

# Predictions
pred <- predict(rf_final, test_rf, type = "prob") %>%
  bind_cols(predict(rf_final, test_rf, type = "class")) %>%
  bind_cols(test_rf %>% select(taxpartsize))

cat("\n=== PARTSIZE (NO UMAP) METRICS ===\n")
print(metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)(pred, truth = taxpartsize, estimate = .pred_class))
print(f_meas(pred, truth = taxpartsize, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro"))

cat("\n=== PARTSIZE (NO UMAP) CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_mat(pred, truth = taxpartsize, estimate = .pred_class))
```
